The hashline port is a REDUCTION, not a byte-equivalent reimplementation: the replaced core's fuzzy autocorrect layer is gone. Nothing in the shipped contract or the tests covers it, but a caller who relied on a mangled replacement being silently repaired will now get the text it actually sent. Declared in vendor/edits.ts and LICENSE-NOTICES.md.

The hashline digest ALGORITHM changed in the sense that the old core could use Bun's native xxHash32 while the new one always uses its own pure-TypeScript xxHash32. Anchors are session-scoped and never persisted, so nothing pinned externally, but I did NOT prove the new digest equals the old one for any given line — no consumer requires it.
